integrity: Unrestricted algebraic proof; standalone finite integer tests are corroborative. Prior formulas and fixed-k work explicitly credited. No independent audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves strictly positive single-projector Schur square and full-rank Cesaro mixing for unweighted KG(2k+1,k), k>=1 only. Does not determine exact spectral gap or finite-time convergence, and does not solve the general primitive distance-regular graph problem. Earlier Johnson-triple projector positivity covers k=3. An equivalent expression in broader Johnson Krein literature remains possible.
title: Single-projector positivity for quantum average mixing on odd graphs
